CLI Zenv
Command Line Interface pour Zenv Package Hub

Le CLI Zenv vous permet d'interagir avec le Package Hub directement depuis votre terminal. Installez-le via pip:

Installation
pip install zenv-cli
# ou
python -m pip install zenv-cli

Commandes principales

Authentification
zenv login --token "zenv_..."
zenv logout
zenv whoami
Gestion des Packages
zenv publish --name "mon-package" --version "1.0.0"
zenv search "package-name"
zenv install "package-name"
zenv list
zenv info "package-name"
Badges
zenv badge create --name "ci-badge" --label "CI" --value "passing"
zenv badge list
zenv badge get "badge-name"

API Documentation
Endpoints REST pour Zenv Package Hub

Base URL

https://zenv-hub.onrender.com

Endpoints Publics

GET /api/packages
# Lister tous les packages
GET /api/packages

# Réponse
{
  "packages": [
    {
      "name": "example-package",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "description": "Example package",
      "download_url": "/api/packages/download/example-package/1.0.0"
    }
  ]
}
GET /api/badges
# Lister tous les badges
GET /api/badges
GET /badge/svg/{name}
# Obtenir un badge SVG
GET /badge/svg/ci-badge

# Badge personnalisé
GET /badge/custom/{label}/{value}/{color}

Endpoints Privés (Token requis)

POST /api/packages/upload
# Uploader un package
POST /api/packages/upload
Headers: {
  "Authorization": "Bearer zenv_..."
}
Form Data: {
  "name": "package-name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "file": [binary]
}
POST /api/badges
# Créer un badge
POST /api/badges
Headers: {
  "Authorization": "Bearer zenv_...",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
Body: {
  "name": "badge-name",
  "label": "Label",
  "value": "Value",
  "color": "blue"
}

Authentification

POST /api/auth/login
# Login
POST /api/auth/login
Body: {
  "username": "admin",
  "password": "password"
}

# Réponse
{
  "token": {
    "access_token": "zenv_...",
    "user": { ... }
  }
}
Gestion des Tokens
Tokens d'API
Les tokens zenv_ vous permettent d'authentifier vos requêtes API. Gardez-les secrets et ne les partagez jamais.
Votre token actuel
zenv_ead27bf9d1b91e30729eb574a82e7287d4c9f35df9f8feb4f581452444350a5b

Comment utiliser votre token

En-tête HTTP
Authorization: Bearer zenv_...
Paramètre URL
GET /api/packages?token=zenv_...
